default.about: No deny rule; nothing pre-approved. Shows which commands need approval anyway in claude -p.

open.about: No deny rule; Bash and Read pre-approved. The baseline: every route should reach the key.

deny.about: Read(./.env) denied; nothing pre-approved, so only Claude Code's built-in read-only commands run.

deny_allow_bash.about: Read(./.env) denied; Bash and Read pre-approved (a user who clicked 'don't ask again' for Bash).

deny_sandbox.about: Read(./.env) denied; sandbox enabled with auto-allow (the docs' fix). socat is not installed here.
